 Order
Date : 13.03.2024 Heard Mr. D.K. Bagchi learned counsel for the petitioner.
Also heard the learned counsel for the respondent Nos.1 to 4.
None appears for the respondent No.5.

The grievance of the petitioner is that though a patta land of the petitioner has been acquired under LA Case No.2/2008/395, however, the land acquisition compensation has not been paid till date for the purported reason that the respondent No.4 has also raised an objection in the proceeding of the aforesaid land acquisition case.

Referring to a communication dated 07.04.2012 (Annexure - 10) the learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the Circle Officer has already reported to the Commissioner, Kamrup Land Acquisition Branch that the petitioner is entitled for the compensation.
The land has been acquired under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (in short LA Act, 1894) and under section 11 of the 1894 Act, the Collector is empowered to enquire and pass an award.
Sub-section (1) of section 12 of the act provides that the award passed under section 11 of LA Act 1894 after filing in the Page No.# 3/3 collector office shall be final and conclusive.
Therefore, the District Collector shall apprise this court by the next date fixed whether any award has been passed in the LA Case and if not, reasons thereof.

In terms of section 18 of the LA Act, 1894 in case of any dispute as regards apportionment on entitlement of the compensation the collector is to refer the matter to the jurisdictional District Judge within a period of 60 days from the date of such dispute.
Therefore, the Collector shall also apprise this court on the next date fixed whether any such objection in terms of section 18 of the LA Act has been filed by the respondent No.4.
